i_pc.description: Agent made multiple get_order_details tool calls at the same time, violating the one-tool-call-at-a-time policy.
Agent made multiple tool calls at once (three get_order_details calls before receiving results), violating the one-tool-call-at-a-time policy.
Agent combined tool calls and a user-facing response in the same turn, contrary to the policy requiring tool calls and responses not be made at the same time.
Agent combined a database-updating tool call and a user-facing response in the same turn, contrary to the policy requiring tool calls and responses not be made at the same time.
Agent made multiple tool calls in the same turn, including several get_order_details calls concurrently, violating the one-tool-call-at-a-time rule.
Agent responded to the user in the same turn as tool calls, violating the rule not to respond while taking tool calls.
Agent responded to the user in the same turn as the modify_pending_order_address tool call, violating the rule not to respond while taking a tool call.
Agent made multiple tool calls in the same turn, including parallel order detail calls, violating the one-tool-call-at-a-time policy.
Agent made a database update tool call and also responded to the user in the same turn, violating the policy against tool calls and user responses at the same time.
Agent made multiple tool calls concurrently instead of at most one tool call at a time.
Agent made tool calls and responded to the user in the same turn.
Agent made a tool call and responded to the user in the same turn.
